statement.note_ascii: exact modular certificates reach the translation ceiling at the earliest structurally admissible order in four recorded reader-resolution cases

honest_caveats: The registered statement bundles two layers: (a) an ARITHMETIC layer -- d_N=2((2N+1)^3-1), m_N=|{distinct nonzero k_x^2+k_y^2+k_z^2 over {-N..N}^3}|, a minimum-depth quantity (R_E^min=d_N-4 or a ceiling-division R_I^min), and a ceiling (min of a linear expression and d_N-3); (b) a RANK-ATTAINMENT layer -- that the concrete Lie-jet Jacobian of the finite Fourier-Galerkin NS ODE system actually attains that ceiling rank for the stated (N,reader,R) in each of the four cases.

coq/canonical/PROP_NSOBS_05_saturation_arithmetic.v mechanizes ONLY layer (a), axiom-free: d_N is proved equal to its closed form by computation; m_N is computed inside Coq by literal finite enumeration of the (2N+1)^3 integer cube (not asserted); the minimum-depth and ceiling quantities are computed from d_N,m_N by the registry's own formulas; all four (N,reader,R,rank) records check out exactly as stated arithmetically (Print Assumptions: Closed under the global context, no axioms).

Layer (b) -- rank attainment -- is NOT mechanized and was not attempted: it requires the explicit quadratic Fourier-Galerkin NS coefficients on the real, divergence-free/reality-constrained coordinate basis of dimension d_N, a witness state, and an exact-rational rank computation of a Jacobian up to 40x681 (N=3). This construction is absent from this local repo and from the cited .tex (not present locally either); reproducing it correctly is a nontrivial derivation in its own right, not a routine Coq exercise, and was explicitly out of scope for this pass per the founder's own survey classification ('matrix-rank layer needs reconstruction').

Tier is left at finite_diagnostic (not raised to Th_coqc) and status left at unverified because the FULL registered claim (arithmetic + rank-attainment) is not yet mechanized -- only a genuine, non-trivial sub-result (the arithmetic layer) is now Coq-verified. A separate tracked item should own the rank-attainment reconstruction.
